Use case: ui-mockup. Create static high fidelity Chinese software DESIGN COMPARISON BOARD for Long编辑. Landscape16:9 with SIX equal mini desktop app views 3columns x2rows. All six examples deliberately use same neutral white/light gray surfaces and blue #2563eb accent, same content and same layout, so differences must come from FORM/SPACING/BORDERS/ELEVATION/TYPOGRAPHY and DOCUMENT BLOCK PRESENTATION rather than mere recoloring.

Main documentsame title项目方案, subheading本周重点, 3checklist lines, shortquote, small3rowtable, onecode snippet. Do not repeat nav labels in a2rowtextgrid.
Six deliberate design personalities:
1 '柔和 · 圆润与层次': 12–16px cardradii, softly elevated rounded file rows, subtly cushioned buttons. Heading plain dark, rounded pastel quote block with narrowaccentrail, rounded softly striped tablecontainer, rounded opaque codeblock. Main content on a soft containedsurface, neutral white not saturatedcolor.
2 '新拟态 · 科技线框': 3–4px smallradii, crisp accentoutlines, directional hardshadow with counterhighlight, compact technical controlgeometry. File rows delineatedthinlines, heading has slim technicalaccentbar, square quote, table visibletechnicalgrid, codeblock thinblueoutline. Avoid squishybig controls.
3 '玻璃 · 透明层叠': 14–20px radii, noticeably layered translucent whitesurfaces over subtle lightblue-gray underlayer, edgehighlights, clear separation/elevation. Crisp text WITHOUTblur. Floatingdocumentpanel, quote glasslayer, table shallowoutlined glasscard. No imagebackground/gradientthat hurtsreading.
4 '呼吸 · 纸张与留白': generousgaps, very light borders, white paperreadingpanel surrounded by modestgray deskbackground, largerreading whitespace, literary serif heading butlegiblesansbody. Filelist spacious flatrows. Quote typographic/indent, table mainlyhorizontal rules, code restrainedbackground.
5 '极简 · 紧凑和平面': compact flatlayout, nearlyno shadows, 4–6px corners, neutralplaintextlabels, densefiletree; no decorativeheadingbar, quote simpleleftthinborder, table cleangrid, simple code. Functioncontrolsnotremoved.
6 '锐利 · 硬边与秩序': squarecornerframes, clear2px contours, hardoffsetshadow small, deliberate gridaligneddensecontrols, file rows square cards and explicitselectedborder, heading straightunderline, quotes square hardoutline, table strongerrow/headerborders, code squareoutlined. Stillwhite/bluepalette, not dark.
This is detailed product UI mockup not illustration, no devices/perspective/arrows. All six visually distinct enough at a glance while preservingidentical functionalpositions. Footer '界面风格、文档排版、文件列表可分别调整；保留全部现有主题与动效'. Do not addfakebackendfeatures.
